name: UE4SS Lua File Bridge
description: File and folder access for UE4SS Lua mods through a native C++ bridge, checked against per-mod access environments: atomic writes, append-only logs, streams and file sockets (Tail).

settings.Label: Enable load-time verifications
settings.Description: Runs the bridge's in-game checks when the game loads and writes PASS and FAIL lines to UE4SS.log. Takes effect on the next launch.
